children: According to CNBC, the buildout of AI data centers is driving demand for HVAC technicians, construction workers, line workers and pipefitters, with labor economists and workforce experts saying the infrastructure behind companies such as Anthropic, Meta, Amazon and OpenAI is creating jobs as well as automating some work. ZipRecruiter labor economist Nicole Bachaud said the mean minimum salary for data center jobs rose 125.1% year over year to nearly $208,000, while postings for welders and pipefitters increased 164% year over year. The report also cited Amazon's $12 billion Louisiana data center project and Meta's $27 billion Hyperion project, along with research from Cushman & Wakefield showing that every 100MW of new data center development creates nearly 1,300 local jobs and about $110 million in annual wages.

title: AI Data Center Boom Is Creating Jobs for Skilled Trades
